                                      Resolution 2025-08
                        Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

      Support for Transfer of Parcel 6-134 from HLB to Girdwood Parks and Recreation

   WHEREAS, Anchorage Parks and Recreation and the subset Girdwood Parks and Recreation is a department of the
    Municipality of Anchorage and is able to manage municipal land; and

   WHEREAS, Girdwood Parks and Recreation manages other lands within Girdwood and is funded by Girdwood Valley
    Service Area property taxes for the benefit of the community as a whole; and

   WHEREAS, transfer of Parcel 6-134 from Heritage Land Bank to Girdwood Parks and Recreation will allow the
   Girdwood Valley Service Area to invest local tax funds in a feasibility study, infrastructure and development that have
    been requested by the community, including development of an RV park; and

   WHEREAS, request of this transfer is supported by the Girdwood Housing and Economic Committee, the Girdwood
   Land Use Committee; and

   WHEREAS, transfer of Parcel 6-134 is consistent with the HLB Annual Work Plan, adopted by the Anchorage Assembly
   on May 20, 2025 and with the newly adopted Girdwood Comprehensive Plan.

   THEREFORE the Girdwood Board of Supervisors resolves its support for HLB transfer of management authority of
    Parcel 6-134 from Heritage Land Bank to Girdwood Parks and Recreation.

    Passed and approved by the Girdwood Board of Supervisors by a vote of 4 in favor and 0 opposed on this 19th day of
   May 2025.




   Mike Edgington
   GHEC Supervisor, GBOS Co-Chair                             Attest
